$comment: E2E suite config. The harness runs every workflow graph discovered in sourceDir against the e2e-server, which fakes all providers (LLM + external/media nodes return type-correct placeholder outputs). prepareSuite.ts reads each template's embedded params; add per-id overrides below when a template needs specific inputs. ids are slugified from the filename (e.g. 'Movie Posters' -> 'movie-posters').
$excludeComment: Workflows this harness cannot run, and why. (1) Trigger workflows whose adapter listens forever: their genProcess waits on a live scheduler or filesystem watcher, and the e2e-server supplies neither, so the run only ends at the timeout — that is the node behaving correctly, an interval trigger left at max_events 0 is supposed to tick forever. Webhook and manual triggers have no genProcess to loop in and stay in the suite; delivered-event coverage for all four is packages/base-nodes/tests/trigger-examples-run.test.ts. (2) Workflows that read or write the workspace: this harness executes the graph inside the browser, which has no filesystem, so workspace.* raises "No workspace is assigned". They run on the desktop app and on a server, which is where a workflow that remembers something between runs belongs.
